description: ### **About the role** Base is a comprehensive operating system for e-commerce that enables businesses to manage all of their online sales processes in one place, from product listing and order handling, through warehouse and shipping management, to repricing and expansion into international markets. Base serves more than 35,000 customers worldwide, processing over 320 million orders and more than $17 billion in GMV annually. The company already operates in 16 countries, including the USA, Germany, the United Kingdom, France, India, and Brazil, building local teams in each of them. We are one of the fastest-growing companies in the industry. We focus on culture, collaboration, and innovation that translate into real impact on how businesses operate. We are strengthening our Corporate Development function and are looking for an **M&A Manager** to lead the evaluation and execution of acquisitions and strategic investments. You will work closely with our Head of Corporate Development as their right hand, focusing on opportunities globally — from companies that complement Base's offering to new markets, technologies and capabilities. This is a hands-on, high-ownership role for an experienced deal professional looking to move in-house, take ownership beyond the transaction itself, and help shape and build our Corporate Development function. ### **Key responsibilities** * **Deal execution:** Own the analysis, execution and project management of M&A transactions and strategic investments. * **Market and target analysis:** Map target markets, analyse competitors and potential acquisition targets, and build business cases for entering new markets. * **Financial analysis and valuation:** Build financial models, benchmark trading and transaction multiples, and prepare investment cases. * **Due diligence:** Coordinate due diligence streams, translating findings into clear recommendations. * **Structuring and negotiation:** Support transaction structuring and negotiations, including term sheets, LOIs, SPAs, earn-outs and management incentive arrangements. * **Deal project management:** Drive transaction projects, as well as post-acquisition integration. ### **What we are looking for** * 3–5 years of experience in private equity, investment banking or M&A advisory. * Hands-on experience working on M&A transactions, across all stages of the deal process. * Strong financial modelling and valuation skills. * Experience coordinating due diligence processes. * Strong analytical and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple workstreams in parallel. * Experience in technology, software, e-commerce or marketplace businesses is a plus. * Excellent written communication skills, **Pace and pragmatism:** You're comfortable with the speed and ambiguity that come with a fast-growing tech company. * **Hands-on approach:** You're happy to roll up your sleeves, moving easily between detailed analysis and big-picture strategy. * **Builder mindset:** You want to help shape a brand-new function, not just slot into an existing one. ### **What we offer** * A global role at the heart of strategy in a fast-growing technology company. * Direct work with the Head of Corporate Development, the Management Board and the shareholders. * Real ownership of transactions and the opportunity to shape how Corporate Development operates as the function scales.
